mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tb_feed WHERE feed_no = #{feedNo} )

SELECT feed_list.feed_no, feed_list.feed_title, feed_list.feed_created, feed_list.user_nickname, feed_list.user_image_url, feed_list.feed_file_path, feed_list.feed_like_visible_yn, ( SELECT COUNT(fl.feed_no) FROM tb_feed_like fl INNER JOIN tb_user flu ON fl.user_no = flu.user_no WHERE fl.feed_no = feed_list.feed_no AND flu.user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT') ) AS feed_like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(fc.feed_no) FROM tb_feed_comment fc WHERE fc.feed_no = feed_list.feed_no AND fc.feed_comment_visible_yn = 'Y' ) AS feed_comment_count FROM ( SELECT f.feed_no, f.feed_title, f.feed_created, f.feed_like_visible_yn, u.user_nickname, u.user_image_url, ff.feed_file_path FROM tb_feed f LEFT JOIN tb_feed_file ff ON f.feed_no = ff.feed_no AND ff.feed_file_sort_order = 1 INNER JOIN tb_user u ON f.user_no = u.user_no WHERE f.feed_visible_yn = 'Y' AND u.user_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT') ORDER BY f.feed_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) feed_list

SELECT f.feed_no, f.feed_title, f.feed_content, f.feed_visible_yn, f.feed_like_visible_yn, f.feed_created, u.user_no, u.user_nickname, u.user_image_url FROM tb_feed f INNER JOIN tb_user u ON f.user_no = u.user_no WHERE f.feed_no = #{feedNo} AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_feed ( user_no, feed_title, feed_content, feed_visible_yn, feed_like_visible_yn, feed_created ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{feedTitle}, #{feedContent}, #{feedVisibleYn}, #{feedLikeVisibleYn}, #{feedCreated} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_feed SET feed_title = #{feedTitle}, feed_content = #{feedContent}, feed_visible_yn = #{feedVisibleYn}, feed_like_visible_yn = #{feedLikeVisibleYn}, feed_updated = #{feedUpdated} WHERE feed_no = #{feedNo}
